subject: Aligning auto-renew carveouts & notice timing — MSA / Order Form redline runbook
messages:
From: Dana Cole <dana.cole@acme-analytics.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@acme-analytics.com, erin.walsh@acme-analytics.com
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 14:10:00 -0500
Subject: Redwood MSA + Order Form — redlines (notice window / termination for convenience)

Hi Rafael,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. Attached is Acme's redline to the MSA and the Order Form (document: Acme_MSA_Redline_v2.docx). Two items we need to flag before legal can approve: 1) a 60-day mutual termination notice for the Order Form (our procurement policy requires 60-day commercial notice for services > $100k ARR); and 2) termination-for-convenience language — we'd like a defined transition assistance period and a capped liability for transition fees.

If Redwood can accept the 60-day notice and the transition assistance carveout (we proposed language in the attached), procurement is ready to proceed to DocuSign. Can your legal team review and get back by EOD Friday (Feb 20)? Our renewal committee meets the following week.

Attachments: Acme_MSA_Redline_v2.docx (redline), OrderForm_ACME_v1_markup.pdf

Best,
Dana Cole
Head of Procurement, Acme Analytics
Dana.Cole@acme-analytics.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0192

From: rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
To: Dana Cole <dana.cole@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood MSA + Order Form — redlines (notice window / termination for convenience)

Thanks Dana — appreciate the clear asks and the marked-up docs. Quick ack: we received the redlines and will treat this as priority.

Action plan on our side:
- I tasked Legal (laura.bennett) to propose language for the notice window and transition assistance by tomorrow EOD PT.
- Marissa (Sales Lead) to confirm whether we can make a Customer-specific exception on notice timing for enterprise accounts in our order form template.
- I will coordinate a final position and provide an updated Order Form or counter-redline by Friday (Feb 20) so you can present to the renewal committee.

Two clarifying Qs for Acme:
1) Is the 60-day notice required to be mutual or only on Acme's side? (Your redline looks mutual but procurement often negotiates mutual.)
2) For transition assistance, do you have a target minimum SLA (hours/week) or a fixed number of engagement days you expect? The redline references 'reasonable assistance' — want to make this concrete if possible.

Onwards — looping in Laura and Marissa.

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
+1 650-555-0133

From: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
To: rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Dana Cole <dana.cole@acme-analytics.com>, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood MSA + Order Form — redlines (notice window / termination for convenience)

On Wed, Feb 18, 2026 at 2:10 PM Dana Cole <dana.cole@acme-analytics.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. Attached is Acme's redline...

Hi all — I reviewed the attached redlines and propose the following pragmatic approach to close this quickly:

1) Notice window: accept a mutual 60-day notice for the Order Form only for enterprise-tier deals > $100k ARR, with the caveat that the MSA stays unchanged for standard customers (we'll add a short Order Form clause: "Order Form termination notice: 60 days mutual where Order Form TCV exceeds $100k)." This limits precedent risk.

2) Termination for convenience: accept in principle but add two protections for Redwood: (a) limit Redwood's obligation to provide transition assistance to a maximum of 30 days or 120 hours, whichever comes first; and (b) cap any transition-related fees at the remaining prepaid amounts or a defined pro-rata fee formula. Suggested language (drafted below) — feel free to paste into your redline document: 

--- suggested clause start ---
Termination for Convenience — Transition Assistance: If either party terminates an Order Form for convenience, Redwood will provide transition assistance for up to thirty (30) calendar days or one hundred and twenty (120) hours (whichever occurs first). Customer shall be responsible for charges for services performed during the transition period at Redwood's then‑current rates. Redwood's aggregate liability for transition assistance shall not exceed the unpaid fees for services under the terminated Order Form for the thirty (30) day period following termination.
--- suggested clause end ---

3) Timing: we can accept turn-around for Friday Feb 20. Marissa — can you confirm sales margin / finance check on this account so we can present terms that are within threshold?

I will prepare a counter-redline with the above language and upload to the shared Drive by EOD PT tomorrow.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com

From: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Dana Cole <dana.cole@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:32:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood MSA + Order Form — redlines (notice window / termination for convenience)

Thanks Laura — that approach looks fine to me. Quick internal note: we are comfortable offering a 60-day mutual notice carveout for Acme given expected ARR and strategic fit; please keep the carveout explicit to the Order Form only (do not amend the master MSA template). Rafael — if legal's proposed transition cap (30 days / 120 hrs) holds, finance has confirmed economics are acceptable for this deal.

If legal posts the counter-redline to Drive, Rafael — please send Acme a single consolidated file with our redline + a short cover note that calls out the two changes (60-day mutual notice on Order Form; transition assistance cap). Goal: get signatures this week.

Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@acme-analytics.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Dana Cole <dana.cole@acme-analytics.com>, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:36:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood MSA + Order Form — redlines (notice window / termination for convenience)

Thanks team — that path works for Acme. We appreciate Redwood keeping the change scoped to the Order Form. Two requests before we finalize: 1) please include the explicit 60-day mutual notice sentence in the Order Form redline; and 2) please upload a single consolidated redline (Acme redlines + Redwood counter) to Drive and send a DocuSign link when ready.

On the transition clause, we are fine with 30 days / 120 hours as long as the language requires Redwood to provide reasonable cooperation to enable a handover (e.g., export of customer data and call with our SREs).

If you can push the consolidated redline and DocuSign link by EOD today PT, we'll route internally and aim to sign before next week's committee meeting.

Best,
Erin Walsh
General Counsel (delegated), Acme Analytics
erin.walsh@acme-analytics.com
